```{ojs}
//| include: FALSE

function initSlider(label, min, max, step, value) {
  return Inputs.range([min, max], {
    label: label,
    value: value ?? Math.random() * (max - min) + min,
    step: step
  });
}
```

## Plot { width=70% }

<div id="harmonograph-container" style="width: 100%; height: 100%; background-color: black;">
<canvas id="harmonograph-canvas" style="display: block; width: 100%; height: 100%;"></canvas>
</div>

```{ojs}
//| include: FALSE
//
// Port of static/javascript/harmonograph.js (p5.js) to plain canvas + OJS.
//

DT = 0.001
ITERATIONS = 10000
TWO_PI = 2 * Math.PI

// Equivalent of setup()/the slider "input" listener/renderHarmonograph().
function drawHarmonograph() {
  const container = document.getElementById("harmonograph-container");
  const canvas = document.getElementById("harmonograph-canvas");
  const width = container.clientWidth;
  const height = container.clientHeight;
  canvas.width = width;
  canvas.height = height;

  const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
  ctx.setTransform(1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0);
  ctx.fillStyle = "black";
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
  ctx.translate(width / 2, height / 2);

  const freq1 = Math.pow(10, f1);
  const freq2 = Math.pow(10, f2);
  const freq3 = Math.pow(10, f3);
  const freq4 = Math.pow(10, f4);
  const phase1 = p1 * TWO_PI;
  const phase2 = p2 * TWO_PI;
  const phase3 = p3 * TWO_PI;
  const phase4 = p4 * TWO_PI;

  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgb(149, 255, 175)";
  ctx.lineWidth = weight;
  ctx.shadowBlur = glow;
  ctx.shadowColor = "rgb(149, 255, 175)";
  ctx.lineJoin = "round";

  ctx.beginPath();
  let t = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < ITERATIONS; i++) {
    const x = a1 * Math.sin(t * freq1 + phase1) * Math.exp(-d1 * t)
            + a2 * Math.sin(t * freq2 + phase2) * Math.exp(-d2 * t);
    const y = a3 * Math.sin(t * freq3 + phase3) * Math.exp(-d3 * t)
            + a4 * Math.sin(t * freq4 + phase4) * Math.exp(-d4 * t);
    if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(x, y);
    else ctx.lineTo(x, y);
    t += DT;
  }
  ctx.stroke();
}
```

```{ojs}
//| include: FALSE
// Equivalent of p.windowResized(): redraw whenever the card is resized.
{
  const container = document.getElementById("harmonograph-container");
  const ro = new ResizeObserver(() => drawHarmonograph());
  ro.observe(container);
}
```

```{ojs}
//| include: FALSE
// Equivalent of the slider "input" listener: redraw whenever a control changes.
{
  f1; f2; f3; f4;
  a1; a2; a3; a4;
  d1; d2; d3; d4;
  p1; p2; p3; p4;
  weight; glow;
  drawHarmonograph();
}
```

```{ojs}
viewof saveButton = Inputs.button("Save PNG", {
  value: null,
  reduce: () => {
    document.getElementById("harmonograph-canvas").toBlob((blob) => {
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const a = document.createElement("a");
      a.href = url;
      a.download = "harmonograph.png";
      a.click();
      URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
    });
  }
});
```
